svg.title: LayerNorm normalizes one token at a time
svg.desc: Layer normalization computes statistics across one token vector’s features and applies learned scale and bias; it behaves the same at training and inference.

g.text: LayerNorm normalizes one token at a time
Unlike BatchNorm, LayerNorm does not depend on other examples or sequence lengths.
LayerNorm computes mean and variance over the d features of one token, then applies learned γ and β.
